evidence.name: Screen field: Spacing between wrapped lines
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Spacing between wrapped lines" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Spacing between wrapped lines
sections.description: Sets the vertical gap between lines when a button label is long enough to wrap onto two or more lines. Most buttons use a single short label, so the default is fine and you can ignore this. Nudge it up only if a multi-line button looks cramped or hard to read.
